integrity: A complete analytical proof and a reproducible SciPy/NumPy verification program are supplied. Numerical finite tests are corroboration, not proof of universal quantifiers. Review is self-review only; independent scientific verification has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: A stationary one-dimensional linear inertial harmonic trap driven by a symmetric rate-rho two-state orientation, with no thermal white noise. The theorem classifies two-time position covariance signs and a first-zero asymptotic, not a full multi-time distribution or experimental resolution threshold. The exact covariance is shared by Gaussian exponentially correlated forcing with matched two-point law. Possible unidentified earlier general colored-noise oscillator sign theorems remain an originality risk.
title: Sharp correlation-sign threshold and first-reversal delay in an inertial run-and-tumble trap
